geometry_notes: Midspan section Б-Б modelled (web 160). Support section В-В (web 260, 1:1 splay 122 high, thickened over ~0.8 m + ~0.5 m taper at each end per plan А-А) is not modelled.

R300 haunch tangent to the slab underside and to the web: the R300 dimension box spans 300 below the slab (measured 304 mm at scale), confirming the tangent construction; a 37 mm straight web length remains between haunch and fillet (derived).
R200 fillet tangent to the web and to the 1:1 splay: its printed vertical projection 141 = 200·sin45° confirms the construction; the splay then reaches x = 310.6 at y = 100 (printed 620/2 = 310).

Top slab of edge beams B1200.174.90/194.90 is asymmetric: 1040 (outer cantilever) + e (700/900) = 1740/1940 = marked width; placed with the 1040 side at -x. Intermediate beams B1200.140.90/180.90 have e both sides (1400/1800). The existing su3503_i33 module symmetrises its slab; this module does not.
The 264 mm rectangles beyond e are protruding joint reinforcement loops (thin lines; the marking width is 'по бетону', i.e. concrete only) and are excluded.

Edge beams: a small drip groove on the slab underside 30 mm from the outer edge (size not legible, ~30 mm) is omitted (convention; < 0.1% of area) -> provenance 'transcribed-with-convention'. Intermediate beams: 'transcribed'.

Validation: published volume/mass (Таблица 1, mass = 2.5 t/m3 × volume). Volume differences between marks (0.36, 0.72, 0.61 m3) equal exactly the slab-width differences × 150 × 12000, confirming the slab dims. Midspan area × 12 m is 3.0–3.5% below the volume for all four marks, a constant excess of 0.200–0.202 m3 per beam attributable to the thickened support webs (≈0.09 m3 from В-В over ~1.05 m per end) plus end details; pinned in tests.
Beam length taken as the marked 12000 mm (the drawing dimension '12000/2' is ambiguous as to whether it is measured from the bearing axis).
